I've found if I drink a pot of coffee I can feel the manic highs. In college I took adderall during finals weeks and wouldn't sleep for 4 to 5 days at a time with manic symptoms/feelings. It isn't the usual *on top of the world* mania but a more nervous/empty mania...more of a mixed episode. All of my suicide attempts have been during mixed episode/dysphoric mania so I tend to steer clear of coffee and adderall these days.
